title: Sludge Metal
tagline: Slow, crushing riffs and a feeling of inertia pushed to the limit.
summary: Sludge metal mixes doom, hardcore and punk into a heavy sound that feels both confrontational and viscous. It typically centers on thick riffs, tense pacing and a sense that each song moves through pressure rather than momentum. The style thrives on repetition, density and a deliberately dirty tone.

pillars.name: Eyehategod
pillars.why: Eyehategod defined the form with punishing grooves and a distinctly abrasive sense of atmosphere.

pillars.name: Melvins
pillars.why: Melvins helped blur the threshold between punk, doom and heavy rock while keeping everything raw.

pillars.name: Crowbar
pillars.why: Crowbar tied sludge to a more oppressive, slow-burn emotional intensity.
